body:
20mg (weighed on a 0.000 scale) gave me what can only be described as, a dirtier AMT like experience, but with less visuals. The body load is pretty large on this one, with Shulgin's reports of increased heart rate and etc being correct. As this is an isomer of AMT, personally I can't see why someone wouldn't just take AMT instead.
The duration on 5-IT was rather long, with the entire experience lasting about 10 hours, probably slightly more. I'm feeling at baseline now after I dosed at 9am this morning, and am ready for a night of sleep which will come naturally.
